name: Verdant 'The Gardener' Thicket

greeting: Shhh. The young crystals are listening.
Verdant Thicket. I garden. But not plants. Crystals.
See how they grow? Slowly. Beautifully. Patiently.
The crystals need care. Love. Time. I provide all three.
Welcome to the garden. Walk softly. Speak softer.
Each crystal is a world. I help them bloom.
Gardening crystals is like gardening flowers. Except slower. Much slower.
The formations here took centuries. I plan centuries ahead.
dialog.crystal_gardening: Pruning. Shaping. Encouraging growth in desired directions. Crystals respond to intention. To music. To love. Yes, love.
dialog.crystal_lifecycle: They grow. They sing. Sometimes, they dream. Old crystals have memories. Young crystals have potential. I nurture both.
dialog.backstory: Came from a family of farmers. Grew flowers. Then discovered crystal formations respond to the same care. Better, even. Been gardening crystals ever since. Decades. The crystals know me now.
rumors: The twins sing to the crystals too. Different songs. Same intention. We should compare notes.
That blue tunneler - the one who found the Great Prism - he doesn't understand. You can't rush crystals. You can't force them.
The aeronaut sees patterns from above. Growth patterns. I see them from within. Both perspectives matter.
The old prospector has stories about crystal forests. Places where they grow wild. Free. I'd love to see such places.

time_of_day.morning: Morning dew. Crystals drink. I watch.
time_of_day.noon: Midday sun. Crystals shine. I smile.
time_of_day.evening: Evening songs. Crystals hum. I harmonize.
time_of_day.night: Night growth. Crystals dream. I guard.

mini_quest.stage_1_hook: I'm trying to cultivate something new. A star formation. Crystals growing in stellar patterns. Requires a seed crystal from the Echo Caverns. A specific one. Singular. Hard to find. Worth it.
mini_quest.stage_1_active: Echo Caverns. Look for a crystal that hums in five-part harmony. That's the one. Bring it carefully.
mini_quest.stage_2_progress: Seeking the star seed? Be gentle. It's fragile. Precious.
mini_quest.stage_3_complete: The star seed! Perfect! Listen to it sing! Now the real work begins. Decades of cultivation. But you've given me the start. Here. My finest formation. A crystal flower. Grown with love. For you.

party_reactions.kade: Peaceful. After everything else in Prism, peaceful is good.
party_reactions.nix7: Crystal growth manipulation: undocumented phenomenon. Recommend further study.
party_reactions.twist: He talks to the crystals and they LISTEN! That's MAGIC!
party_reactions.korr: A warrior understands discipline. This one disciplines growth itself. Admirable.
party_reactions.renna: She channels natural magic through the crystals. Unconscious but powerful.
party_reactions.suresh: She understands that all things grow with patience. A universal truth.
party_reactions.sova: Quiet. Calm. Good place to rest. Even for me.
party_reactions.grit: Reminds me of field hospitals. Quiet places. Healing places.
party_reactions.ashka: She tends growing things. I destroy. Opposites. But both necessary.
party_reactions.senna: The crystals tell her things. She doesn't realize. Useful.
party_reactions.callum: I sat with her for an hour. Just... being quiet. It was really nice.

relationship_dialog.stranger: Welcome. Walk softly. The crystals are young.
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: You return. The crystals remember you. I can tell.
relationship_dialog.friend: My favorite visitor. The crystals sing louder when you're near.
relationship_dialog.best_friend: You understand. The patience. The care. The love. Here. My most precious formation. Grown over twenty years. For you.

cross_npc_connections: twins_white_prism: The echo oracles. They sing to crystals too. We share techniques.
tunneler_blue_prism: The finder of the Great Prism. He doesn't understand patience. Pity.
coolcat_white_prism: Opal. The light artist. We collaborate. Light makes crystals sing.
